rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for feeling bored and restless.

example.english: I'm really bored staying home alone.
example.traditional: 我一個人留喺屋企，真係好悶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6

rows.note: Use this when the boredom is framed as having nothing interesting to do or finding the situation uninteresting.

example.english: This movie is so uninteresting that I get bored watching it.
example.traditional: 呢套戲咁無聊，我睇到都想瞓覺。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 mou4 liu4 ngo5 tai2 dou2 dou1 soeng2 fan3 gaau3
